The person behind the planning

G. Balaji

Director · BG. Event Management

Based in Madurai. Here for your moments.

A personal approach.
A dependable team.

Every gathering has its own purpose, people and personality. Our job is to understand yours, then make the planning feel clear and manageable.

We combine creative thinking with practical coordination: schedules, suppliers, venue requirements, production and the finishing touches. From intimate family celebrations to larger public occasions, we bring the same attention and care.

Our promise is simple: listen carefully, communicate clearly and deliver with care.
